documents.title: Receipt Of Trading Approval For 15,01,434 Equity Shares Of Face Value Rs. 2/- Each

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported a turnover of 700 crores and sales volumes of 5,200 tons for Q1 FY27, achieving its highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43%. The company is undergoing a corporate restructuring to demerge its copper business into a new wholly owned subsidiary called Tieramet Limited. Management proposed a capex of 40 crores over the next two years (FY27 and FY28) and expects volume growth of 12% to 15% for the full year. Bhagyanagar India Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting a revenue of INR 70,507.54 lakhs and a PAT of INR 2,024.52 lakhs. Management detailed ongoing corporate restructuring under a composite scheme of arrangement involving the amalgamation of BCPL and demerger of the copper business into Tieramet Ltd.

guidance.claim: The company hopes to maintain its EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5% going forward in the year.
guidance.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting an export contribution of between 12% and 15% this year.
guidance.quote: One moment. It will be a minimum of 10%, but we are targeting more towards 15%, so we are looking at somewhere between 12% and 15% this year.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of achieving 5,000 crores of revenue by FY30.
guidance.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

guidance.claim: Management targets reaching 5,000 crores in the year 2030, which translates to a 25% CAGR.
guidance.quote: Our top line projection, as in earlier, this thing, has been project... we are aiming for 3,000 crores in the year 2030. That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030. We are, in 5 years, we are planning to... 3 years, and we are planning to double the turnover to 5,000 crores, which translates in Between 20% to 25% CAGR. 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth of 20% and a 5% increase in prices out of a 25% growth projection.
guidance.quote: Out of the 25%, we are expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices.

guidance.claim: Management is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

demand_outlook.claim: Secondary copper demand in India is expected to double from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons in the next five years.
demand_outlook.quote: Out of this, if you look at the secondary copper demand, it is expected to double in the next 5 years, from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.

demand_outlook.claim: Management sees a lot of demand as of today.
demand_outlook.quote: As of today, we see a lot of demand.

demand_outlook.claim: All of the company's customers are looking to increase their volumes and double their capacity in the next three years.
demand_outlook.quote: All our customers are looking to increase their volumes and everybody is talking about doubling their capacity in the next 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: India is projected to consume around 2.4 million metric tons of copper by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: As we can see, India is actually one of the fastest growing copper users in the world, with around 2.4 million metric tons projected to be consumed in India by 2030.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.
demand_outlook.quote: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the world copper consumption is predicted to become 50 million tonne by 2050.
demand_outlook.quote: The world consumed around 26 million tonne of copper, which is predicted to become 50 million tonne by 2050, so this is almost doubling.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has proposed 40 crores of capex over the next two years, covering FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects its capacity expansion from 35,000 to 45,000 tons to become operational between April and June of next year.
capex_expansion.quote: The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to form a new wholly owned subsidiary called Tieramet Limited to hold its copper business.
capex_expansion.quote: We are going to form a new company called Tieramet Limited, which will be a wholly owned subsidiary of Bhagyanagar India.

capex_expansion.claim: Management proposed a capex of 40 crores in the next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we have, proposed 40 crores capex in the last, in the next 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling.
capex_expansion.quote: So, right now, we are planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling, where the cable waste comes in, we process them into different grades, we make granules, and with aluminium and other metals, we make ingots, and then we put them back into the supply chain.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved an EBITDA margin of 5.43% and a PAT margin of 2.87% in the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: We have had our highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43%, our highest PAT margin of 2.87%.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved sales volumes of 5,200 tons and an EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.
margins_costs.quote: We have achieved sales volumes of 5,200 tons. We have also had our highest share of value-added products sold this quarter, which is 63% and our highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.

margins_costs.claim: The removal of customs duty from January 1, 2025, helped increase margins.
margins_costs.quote: Also, the customs duty has been removed from 1st January 2025, so that has also helped us increase our margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company increased its margins in the first two months by taking advantage of trade route disruptions and material shortages.
margins_costs.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported an operational EBITDA margin of 46% and a PAT margin of 2.1% in the brief summary of financials.
margins_costs.quote: Our operational EBITDA margin is 46%, our PAT margin is 2.1%, and our PE ratio is 17.71%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has completed adding its capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is now online.
orders_capacity.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's CTC wires capacity is roughly 80 metric tons a month and will increase to 150 metric tons a month.
orders_capacity.quote: On CTC wires, our capacity is roughly about 80 metric tons a month and we will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the company's capacity reached 35,000 metric tonne this year.
orders_capacity.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated copper sales volume increased by 34% from 18,000 metric tonne to 24,000 metric tonne last year.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has finalized a first round of fundraising of 52 crores, with funds expected in August.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we have just finalized the first round of raising, at 52 crores, which is finalized, and the money should be in the bank in the month of August.

capital_allocation.claim: The second tranche of fundraising will likely occur around March after the demerger is completed.
capital_allocation.quote: The second tranche will probably be around March, after the demerger is done, in the standalone copper unit.

capital_allocation.claim: Projections show that the company's debt will be around 325 crores in 2030.
capital_allocation.quote: The projection is showing that around 325 crores will be the debt in 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: The total fund raise through preferential allotment is INR 52.25 Crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Trade route disruptions and material shortages caused turnover to decrease in the first two months.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced a GST impact of 17 to 18 crores due to the retrospective cancellation of a supplier's registration.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because of the retrospective cancellation of the registration of the supplier, the case has been put on us.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sales volumes decreased by 9.5% from the last quarter and 6.5% from the previous year to 5,278 tons.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our sales volumes have dropped, though; they have gone to 5,278 tons, which is a 9.5% decrease from the last quarter and a 6.5% decrease from last year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that scrap coming from the Gulf has suddenly dried up and lead times are impacted.
risks_headwinds.quote: The scrap coming from Gulf, which is of a short duration, short lead time material, has suddenly dried up.

management_commitments.claim: The company has proposed to execute 40 crores of capex over the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to complete a digital transformation over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.

management_commitments.claim: The government mandated that all new products made from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5 percent recycled content starting from FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Government has mandated that all new products made from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content (starting from FY28)

management_commitments.claim: Management stated the company is planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.
management_commitments.quote: That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated the company is planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.
management_commitments.quote: And over here, as mentioned, we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
